items.title: Claude Code’s suggested message feature: I think the real customer is the model
items.summary_zh: Claude Code 新增建议消息功能，认为真正的用户是模型自身。
items.why_zh: 对 AI 工程师值得关注：该功能让模型能自我引导提示，提升代码生成可控性。

items.title: lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar
items.summary: Claude Code skill for short films with no video model: 43 film styles, each a style prompt plus a demo film made entirely in code by Claude Opus 5.5 (incl. OPUSCAR 98). By Lemomo. | Opus5.5 x 43 种影片风格：风格提示词 + 纯代码样片 + 导演与技术指南
items.summary_zh: Claude Opus 5.5 生成 43 种电影风格的纯代码短片，附风格提示词和导演指南。
items.why_zh: 展示大模型直接输出可运行代码实现多风格视觉内容，为程序化创作提供新范式。

items.title: Clearailhc/clearai-dsh
items.summary: ClearAI is a native DSH plugin that brings the Epistemic Loop to DeepSeek Harness.
items.summary_zh: ClearAI 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 DSH 插件，引入认知循环机制。
items.why_zh: 将认知循环嵌入模型 harness，有助于提升推理一致性和可调试性，对工程师有实用价值。

items.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 公布数学领域最新进展，包含预印本论文和代码仓库。
items.why_zh: 提供前沿数学推理模型和数据，帮助 AI 工程师研究形式化推理与证明生成。

items.title: GAMEGO: Training Game-Dev Agents with Synthetic Trajectories Anchored in Real-World Assets
items.summary: arXiv:2610.06910v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in web front-end execution, with browser-based game generation emerging as a particularly prominent frontier. While previous efforts frequently rely on complex multi-turn workflows or focus on static game evaluation benchmarks, this work targets direct end-to-end real-world game synthesis driven by coding agents. However, generating complex games directly from
items.summary_zh: 使用合成轨迹训练游戏开发代理，锚定真实世界资产实现端到端游戏生成。
items.why_zh: 直接从资产生成可玩游戏，降低多步骤工作流复杂度，为 AI 驱动的内容创作提供新路径。

items.title: Text2Dashboard: A Governed Agent Architecture for Natural-Language Dashboard Generation over Enterprise DataBrain
items.summary: arXiv:2610.06914v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Text2Dashboard is a DataBrain-specific prototype that turns natural-language analytic requests into inspectable dashboards. An installable Codex plugin and standalone Agent Runtime combine schema-constrained model decisions with typed tools, persistent state, and deterministic Hooks for approval, audit, checkpointing, recovery, and failure handling. The pipeline resolves entities, discovers metadata, enforces read-only SQL, composes dashboards, and
items.summary_zh: Text2Dashboard 将自然语言分析请求转换为可检查的企业仪表盘，含插件和运行时。
items.why_zh: 提供可审计、可恢复的仪表盘生成流程，满足企业级数据可视化的治理需求。

items.title: shader-effects-inc/shaders
items.summary: WebGPU components for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, JS & Framer
items.summary_zh: 提供适用于 React、Vue 等框架的 WebGPU 组件库。
items.why_zh: 让前端开发者轻松使用 WebGPU 进行高性能图形计算。

items.title: DenRakEiw/scumble
items.summary: Free, open-source desktop editor for AI inpainting: select, prompt, get a colour-matched layer. FLUX 3 Image, FLUX.2, GPT Image, Nano Banana, Seedream and Qwen through your API key or your own ComfyUI. Layers, PSD export, MCP.
items.summary_zh: 开源 AI 修图桌面编辑器，支持多种模型及 PSD 导出。
items.why_zh: 集成多模型与图层操作，便于工程师快速构建修图工作流。

items.title: Production Monitoring with Codex: Grafana, Kubernetes, & Security
items.summary: It’s 3 a.m. and checkout errors are climbing. What do you check first? Join cohosts Tony Loehr and Anke Hao for three practical production-monitoring demos with Codex. Follow a checkout failure in Grafana, investigate a Kubernetes rollout that causes out-of-memory restarts, and explore how a Codex Security finding connects service availability to a missing resource limit. See how telemetry, release history, and code support an investigation; learn how engineers review a proposed change and check…
items.summary_zh: 使用 Codex 演示在 Grafana、K8s 中进行故障排查与安全监控。
items.why_zh: 展示如何利用 AI 辅助定位服务可用性问题，提升运维效率。

items.title: Building Engine v2: How LangChain approaches agent improvement
items.summary: Ben Tannyhill, Product Manager at LangChain, explains how his team builds and evaluates LangSmith Engine, the agent in LangSmith that finds issues in production traces, proposes fixes, and creates evals to catch regressions. He covers the per-task benchmarks behind Engine's 2x better error identification on IssueBench, how the team runs Engine on LangChain's own go-to-market and coding agents and on Engine itself, and why a smaller model is sometimes the better choice for a simple task. He then …
items.summary_zh: 介绍 LangSmith Engine 如何通过基准评估提升 Agent 错误检测能力。
items.why_zh: 描述其在 IssueBench 上错误识别提升 2 倍的方法，可参考用于 Agent 改进。

items.title: What is Deep Agents? An open source harness for long-running agents.
items.summary: What is Deep Agents? An open source harness for long-running agents. When it comes to agents, the harness is what decides whether it can actually finish long, complex tasks instead of falling apart. An agent is just a model plus a harness. Deep Agents is LangChain's open-source, model-neutral harness. It gives any LLM the context management, tools, memory, subagents, sandboxes, and human-in-the-loop controls it needs to run longer and do more. In this Short, learn how: ✅ The AI harness controls …
items.summary_zh: Deep Agents 提供模型中立的 Agent 框架，包含上下文、工具、记忆等。
items.why_zh: 使任意 LLM 能胜任长复杂任务，降低自研 Agent 开发成本。

items.title: Advancing computer use with Ironclad
items.summary: Learn how OpenAI and Ironclad are training and evaluating AI agents on complex contracting workflows to advance computer use for professional work.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 与 Ironclad 合作训练 AI Agent 处理复杂合同工作流。
items.why_zh: 展示 AI 在专业法律场景中的实际应用路径，可借鉴 Agent 设计。

items.title: Can a Cloud-Native Harness Make Agents Reliable Beyond the Desktop?
items.summary: Kubernetes co-creators Craig McLuckie and Joe Beda aim to bring agent harnesses fully into the cloud.
items.summary_zh: Kubernetes 联合创始人 Craig McLuckie 和 Joe Beda 计划将代理 harness 完全迁移到云端。
items.why_zh: 云原生 harness 能让代理在分布式环境中更可靠、可伸缩，便于大规模强化学习。

items.title: Agent Lightning v1.0: A 3,500-Line Lightweight Agentic RL Framework for Training Agents with Real Harnesses
items.summary: Training AI agents with reinforcement learning can be challenging because their tools, context, and decision-making are managed by complex frameworks. Agent Lightning connects existing agents to RL training, making it easier to improve them without rebuilding them. The post Agent Lightning v1.0: A 3,500-Line Lightweight Agentic RL Framework for Training Agents with Real Harnesses appeared first on Microsoft Research .
items.summary_zh: Agent Lightning 提供仅 3500 行的轻量级代理 RL 框架，可直接接入现有代理进行强化学习训练。
items.why_zh: 低门槛、轻量化的 RL 框架让工程师能快速在真实 harness 上迭代优化代理，无需重构。
